create.name: Nola Bloom
create.bio:
Nola Bloom is a Canadian teacher of yoga, meditation and Yoga Nidra, and a bodyworker, who has lived on the Thai island of Koh Phangan for close to twenty years. She came to this work through touch: after training in esthetics at the Aveda Institute in 2002, she went on to study Ayurvedic head massage, Chi Nei Tsang and a flowing massage style of her own. Her first yoga teacher training followed in Thailand in 2009, then study in India and several years of Ashtanga practice, which gradually softened into Yin, gentle Vinyasa, breathwork and Yoga Nidra.

On the island she teaches public Yin and gentle flow classes, among them a candlelit Yin session with live piano, and holds Full Moon and New Moon circles for women as well as ceremonial cacao gatherings. She also works one to one, in person or online, through private yoga, meditation and cacao sessions. Yoga philosophy runs through everything she shares: her Insight Timer courses walk through Patanjali's eight limbs and the yogic view of rest, and she has designed The Wisdom of Yoga Oracle, a set of 52 cards with a guidebook on the core ideas of yoga. She also hosts The Blooming Spirit Podcast of meditations and dharma talks.

courses.title: An Embodiment Journey Into The Eight Limbs Of Yoga
courses.description: An eight-day audio course on Insight Timer that takes one of Patanjali's eight limbs each day, from ethics and daily habits through posture and breath to concentration and absorption. Each lesson mixes a short teaching with meditation, visualisation and journalling prompts.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: The Wisdom Of Rest
courses.description: A three-day Insight Timer course on rest as a yogic practice. Each day pairs a short reflection drawn from the Yoga Sutras, on awareness, surrender and coming back to a natural rhythm, with a guided meditation or Yoga Nidra.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Private Meditation Sessions with Nola Bloom
courses.description: One-hour online sessions in which Nola builds a meditation practice around what you want to work on, with guidance you can keep using at home.

courses.title: Align & Flourish Yoga Session
courses.description: A private hour of yoga shaped to your level and aims, offered online or in person on Koh Phangan, with attention to alignment and a home practice you can carry on with. A package of three sessions is also listed.

courses.title: Private 1:1 Cacao Ceremony
courses.description: A ninety-minute ceremony built around your own intention, sharing ceremonial cacao alongside meditation, breathwork, music and simple ritual. Available online, or in person on Koh Phangan for individuals, couples and small groups.

courses.title: Full Moon & New Moon Women's Ceremonies
courses.description: Regular gatherings for women at Arcana Wellness Village on Koh Phangan, timed to the moon. Each circle combines guided meditation, gentle movement, a shared altar and intention setting, celebrating at the full moon and planting new intentions at the new moon.

free_resources.title: Nola Bloom on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Nola's guided meditations, Yoga Nidra journeys and short talks on yoga philosophy, free to hear in the app or on the web, along with her free live sessions.

free_resources.title: The Blooming Spirit Podcast
free_resources.description: Nola's free podcast of guided meditations, Yoga Nidra, affirmations and reflections on yoga philosophy, also available on Spotify.
